segments.text: A lot of the patients that I treat are suffering from stroke and heart attack, hip replacement, knee replacement, things of that nature.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So when these people get admitted to the hospital, they have to take a PCR test first.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So someone experiencing a heart attack will be picked up by the ambulance, taken to the hospital.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The hospital will administer a PCR test.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: If the PCR test comes back positive,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They admit this patient as a COVID patient.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They don't admit them as a heart attack patient.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They don't admit them for myocardial infarction.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I've had stroke patients that I've treated that were admitted or taken to the hospital for stroke, but when they get there, PCR test says positive.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So they're labeled as a COVID admission.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Even though when they were there, they were never treated for COVID.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: and they were only treated for their stroke.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So there's just this huge misrepresentation, just complete fraud with this system.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
